note: States of the hero (PixelLab /create-character-state): him holding each weapon. The one chosen for a weapon is the character every drawing of that weapon is made from.

The Hammer A.edit: he holds a heavy long-handled sledgehammer in both hands instead of the curved blade: a big square head of grey stone with one dark iron band across its middle, a long wooden haft. No sword.

The Hammer B.edit: he holds a heavy long-handled sledgehammer in both hands instead of the curved blade: a big square head of pale rough stone that glows blue from within, thin cracks of bright blue light across it, a long wooden haft. No sword.

The Clapper A.edit: he holds a flail instead of the curved blade: a heavy dark bronze bell clapper, a long teardrop of metal, hanging from his hand on a length of thick pale rope. No sword.

The Clapper B.edit: he holds a flail instead of the curved blade: a short wooden handle, a dark iron chain, and at the end of the chain a heavy bronze bell tongue like a club head. No sword.

The Tooth A.edit: he holds a long spear upright in both hands instead of the curved blade: the whole spear is one long spike of pale blue ice like a great fang, as tall as he is. No sword.

The Tooth B.edit: he holds a long spear upright in both hands instead of the curved blade: a dark wooden shaft, and bound to its tip with red cord a great white curved fang of a beast, rimed with frost. No sword.

The Bow A.edit: he holds a tall dark storm bow in his forward hand instead of the curved blade: the bow is black with pale blue glowing tips, and its string is a bright glowing blue-white line of lightning, clearly visible; a quiver on his back. No sword.

The Bow B.edit: he holds a tall plain wooden longbow in his forward hand instead of the curved blade, its grip wrapped in red cord, a quiver of pale arrows on his back. No sword.

The Thorns A.edit: he holds two hooked short swords instead of the curved blade, one in each hand, both pointing forward and clearly visible: pale bone-white blades shaped like big rose thorns with dark red grips. No sword.

The Thorns B.edit: he holds two short straight daggers, one in each hand, instead of the curved blade: black iron blades shaped like rose thorns, grips wrapped in red. No sword.
